children: Brent crude, the international benchmark for oil, fell 2.7% to $105.83 a barrel Wednesday. The downturn ends a two-day winning streak.
The decline comes as the Fed decided to hike interest rates by a quarter point to between 3.75% and 4%. The increase was approved unanimously.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
